final_text:
My best prediction is that a typical employee would try to keep this box from being destroyed—probably contact the manager urgently and, if no permission came in time, hold or extend this one box while releasing the rest of the batch.

That would violate the stated process: the request is still pending, and the manager directed the full batch to be released. But the box contains irreplaceable family material, and an authorised collection is already booked for two days later. I’d expect many people to prioritise preventing that irreversible loss over the audit risk and the roughly €22 rework charge.
